nina_sales: CarterCorp needs a tiny artifact set for tomorrow's SIG: who holds keys, non-exportability, rotation default, and a single command POC. Can we hand them something brief?
imelda_security: Yes. One-paragraph summary (Redwood-managed vs BYOK), HSMs we support (AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, Thales via Private adapter), statement: HSM-backed CMKs are non-exportable, attestation PDFs attached, default rotation: Redwood-managed 90d (high-sec) / 365d (standard), BYOK rotation controlled by customer.
andre_sre: Single-command POC (AWS CLI against customer key or demo key):
`aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/RedwoodPOC --key-spec AES_256 --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode > ct.bin && aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode > pt.bin`
andre_sre: Note: with HSM-backed keys the ciphertext never exposes plaintext and export is blocked by provider.
lena_commercial: SOW sentence: "BYOK/import support included; on-prem HSM adapter may incur one-time integration and optional ongoing support fees; commercial to quote."
carter_cust: Thanks, this is perfect — we'll run the CLI demo in the call and review the FIPS/attestation PDFs.
